This '''pin-up of a Pantoran''' was a decorative [[Painting/Legends|poster]] grazing the walls of the [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It depicted a young [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/lethal-trackdown-trivia-gallery|text="Lethal Trackdown" Trivia Gallery|quote=The nightclub on Coruscant is filled with posters of various female pin-up models}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref> posing in a revealing [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Clothing/Legends|dress]], with her bare back to the viewer as she gazed over her shoulder. The Pantoran sported a yellow [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] on her back.<ref name="Lethal Trackdown" />
